title: ThinkLatent site — v9: Mandate chapters and Home hero

n_main.text: Home · v9 (2026-11-16, D-379; from the 15 Nov scout pass 2, Factory and Infinite Garden as inspiration, structure only): eight sections. 1 Hero, line A: 'The Enterprise shouldn't have to start from zero.' over 'Owned models. Inside the boundary.', supporting line, buttons Start a use case (red, tier 2) and How we build responsibly; under it the portal's command centre as a looping capture (Hero web part + Stream web part, tier 1; a static snapshot of the system map holds the slot until the portal runs). 2 Running on TLM: business-line names, not logos, each with its team's agreement (Text, tier 1). 3 Pillars 01 Kept, 02 Proven, 03 Compounding, worded to D-192 (Text in three columns, tier 1). 4 Proof panel: four numerals and a row per business line with source and as-of (numerals tier 2; rows as a List, tier 1); replaces the compounding strip, so 35M+ and ~200 come off Home; the latest win, this quarter's awards, the new-partner post and This month sit under it. 5 Named products (Quick Links Grid). 6 Four doors + the Work with ThinkLatent ladder (governance door reworded to D-192). 7 Latest from the team (News) with the community (Viva Engage) and Use AI at the Enterprise links. 8 Closing band: 'Which part of your work should the model learn next?' + Start a use case (Call to action, tier 1). Static only: no scroll animation.

n_mandate.text: Mandate · v9 (2026-11-16, D-379): five numbered chapters on one spine, each with a static diagram (decided 2026-11-15). Hero: 'ThinkLatent builds the Enterprise's own AI, and keeps everything it learns.' + chapter jump links + the spine image (streams of dots into the orb of six wavy rings, one dotted line dropping out; Image web part, tier 1). 01 Today (copy + the Head of ThinkLatent pull quote; diagram: use case → general model → months of setup → one answer, dots scatter). 02 Vision (knowledge gathered into TLM, powering advice, compliance review, servicing, cyber defence, knowledge). Statement line: 'One system, every team, every lesson kept.' 03 Approach (the system map as a static snapshot, placeholder counts; approval stays with model risk management). 04 Generations, safer line 'trained on more of the Enterprise's own data' (board note: original line pending Applied Research). 05 The loop: the index panel, layout only until the portal supplies sourced counts (board note), then the four measured targets with Target and Today lines (D-137) under it. Close: the spine fans out to five kinds of work, 'Intelligence the Enterprise owns, and that grows every time it is used.', ThinkLatent., Start a use case + How we build responsibly. Each chapter is a two-column section (Text + Image web parts, tier 1); the dotted spine down the left and the numbered markers are tier 2 (custom.css), and without them the chapters stand as numbered sections. Diagrams use JetBrains Mono for small labels (kit's second voice, decision 3 of 15 Nov); on SharePoint they are images, so no font request.

n_products.text: Products · v7 (features 2, 9, 18, 19, 40). Hero with in-page nav · TLM lineage as a static Image (five generations, TLM4 branching into Core, Distil, Domain; the interactive one lives in the portal) · three short outcome cards, one per tier, each linking the full card in the ThinkLatent Portal (Quick Links or Text cards) · generations in outcomes · ThinkLatent Portal section with the platform pieces · TL Index summary tile with as-of date and the three-line explainer (Text; numbers from the TL Index only) · Use AI at the Enterprise links · Releases (News, Category = Release). Owners: site editor + Head of AI Products.

n_trust.text: How we build responsibly · v8.1 (D-191, renamed from ThinkLatent Trust after the stress-test critique and a simulated Risk review): opens with 'supports, and does not replace, the Enterprise's model risk management'. Jump links · six steps (intake with inventory registration, risk classification of every use case by Risk, developer evaluation on the TL Index labelled 'not model validation', independent validation by Risk which ThinkLatent does not sign, human review at the level the approval sets, monitoring with escalation through the model risk issue process), each with who is responsible and what you see (Text cards, three across) · what we show and what we don't (limits only for approved models) · process stage by product with inventory record links, reconciled monthly, neutral stage labels (List web part) · policy, model inventory and owners (four links) · governance question (Forms; no Risk response time promised) · owners, review line ('Wording reviewed by the Enterprise's model risk management on [date]. This review is not approval or validation of any model.') and a corrections log. Goes live only after the real Risk review, a company-version step.

n_team.text: Team · v7 (features 5, 22, 29, 35, 42). Three function cards with a mission line, the head and a quarterly output count (Text) · profiles heads-first, each auto-listing the person's posts and publications (Highlighted content by author); everyone else in the People web part with role labels and start years · three locations · how we work (unchanged) · six awards + recognition (winners featured on Home, Viva Engage shout-out) · 'Work in ThinkLatent' slot marked after launch.

n_wins.text: Wins · v7 (features 8, 25, 39). Featured win: story + before/after number with source and date + partner quote + 'what compounded' · wins as a List (filters: year, business unit, product; gallery or list) · new partners: a post per engagement (News, Category = Partner) · what partner teams say (one quote rotates on Home) · Bring us a problem (Forms with a named owner; hands off to ThinkLatent Portal intake later).

n_research.text: Research · v7 (feature 10, Capital One layout). Three themes · the university lab in order: intro and link to the lab site, four project cards, the Head of ThinkLatent quote, joint outputs (Publications filtered the university), MScAC interns, events, directors, partner stories, lab tours marked later · methods in use. The teal section is the immersive moment.

n_pubs.text: Publications · v7 (feature 16). List web part filtered by type, year, theme, the university and status (internal memo, external, patent, talk, filed, in production), authors linked to profiles · conference roundups, one post per conference (News, Category = Roundup) · in the news (links only; Comms approval kept per row).

n_blog.text: Blog · v7 (features 11, 12, 15, 33, 39). Filters as button links incl. Perspective, Deep dive, conference roundups, year in review · featured post · cards carry the Perspective or Deep dive chip · 'ThinkLatent in 2026' year-in-review block (every January) · leadership series · how the blog runs (BAIR model: researchers write, 2–3 editors + a function-head advisor, at most two posts a month, one leadership post (the four leaders in turn) and one from the team (v8, D-137), syndication to the intranet and the office news, the external blog via Comms later) · newsletter archive (the newsletter stays an email). Comments on, moderated.

n_persp.text: AI Perspectives · v7 (features 13, 14, 20, 26). Teal hero · next session with abstract, host bio and guest · schedule as text (table) with the demo edition marked after launch · recordings library (Stream; also onboarding) · ask for it on the roadmap (Forms) + Viva Engage feed · two after-launch panels: the quarterly demo edition (8–12 minute talks, live demo each, one Q&A, recorded, recap) and the podcast pilot. v8 (D-137): both panels kept and labelled 'Coming'.

n_viday.text: ThinkLatent Day · v7 (features 36, 37): yearly, alongside the Enterprise's AI Summit. Hero with date, days, teams · how it runs (before, day 1, day 2, after) · this year's three themes + judging questions · sign up a team (Forms; business teams first, ThinkLatent builders matched) · ThinkLatent at the AI Summit sessions · past winners (winners join the quarter's awards; the best idea enters the Idea Lab as a Seed). v8 (D-137): deferred. Built on the test site, published once the Enterprise's AI Summit date is set.

n_gloss.text: Glossary · v7 (feature 23): 44 terms, one line each, as a List web part filtered by letter; owned by the editorial board; Perspective posts link here instead of explaining.

n_glance.text: ThinkLatent at a glance · v7 (feature 30): one plain page (headings and lists, every number with a source) so Copilot, search and a new colleague can answer 'what has ThinkLatent done on X?'; kept current each quarter by the site editor. Text web parts only. v8: takes Home's 'questions teams ask first' as a plain list (answers in brackets, each with a person to ask).

n_write.text: Write for ThinkLatent · v7 (features 11, 12, 31, 32, 42). Jump links · eleven templates (+ Win story, Model card, Conference roundup, New partner) as Quick Links Grid · Perspective vs Deep dive · three steps (review within five working days) · how the blog runs · the ThinkLatent voice · submit (Forms). Owners: site editor + editorial advisor.

n_tpl.text: Templates · v7 (features 31, 32, 33). All eleven carry the new chrome, comments (on everywhere, moderated) and the footer. Release notes gained Getting started (three links: access, the Relay call, the portal card and playground), Acknowledgments and Contact; links go to the portal card and the index run, never weights or code. New: Win story (story, before/after number, partner quote, what compounded), Model card (what for, who uses it, limits plainly, the index, access; full card in the portal), Conference roundup (who went, three things we bring back, who to ask), New partner (problem in their words, what starts, first milestone, contact). Save each as a SharePoint page template; the Category property drives the News filters. v8 (D-137): all eleven kept. Use case is now one page per use case, kept current, and Win story is one moment with one number that links to it. Model card: the portal card wins where they differ, and the site editor checks each card every quarter. Leadership series: one post a month across the four leaders, in turn.

nav.text: Navigation · v7 (feature 21): Mandate · Products ▾ (TLM, ThinkLatent Portal, the TL Index, How we build responsibly) · Our work ▾ (Wins, Research, Publications) · Stories ▾ (Blog, AI Perspectives, ThinkLatent Day) · Team, plus the red Write for ThinkLatent button; Home is the logo. SharePoint: hub mega menu, two levels. Active item sage with green 900 text (custom.css). Footer: Follow, Viva Engage, site map incl. Glossary and ThinkLatent at a glance, products, elsewhere, contact the editors.

fid.text: Fidelity (v9, 2026-11-16: Mandate rebuilt as five chapters and Home merged to eight sections from the 15 Nov scout pass 2, D-379; v8.1, 2026-11-07: the governance page renamed How we build responsibly and redrawn after the critique and simulated Risk review, D-191; v8: the v7 review applied, D-137, on the v7 base of 2026-11-05): the v3 structure and the kit's colour system v1.1 (primary green, secondary teal, Decision Red on buttons and the stripe), no imagery (flat plate tints hold every image slot until the team's image set exists), and the 42 feature decisions from the scout inventory built in. Generated from gen/site6.py + pages_a–e.py (pages) and gen/tpl6.py (templates). SharePoint: T1 = theme, sections, Text, Quick Links, News, Events, People, Lists with column formatting, Highlighted content, Call to action, Page properties, Embed, Forms, Viva Engage; T2 = custom.css for the red buttons and stripe, pills, radii, glass, numerals. Two owners and a review date on Mandate, Products, How we build responsibly, Write for ThinkLatent, Glossary and ThinkLatent at a glance. Comments on everywhere except Home.

src.text: Content sources: the register and capability catalogue (TLM1–5, Core/Distil/Domain, Relay, HyperPod, self-healing, AI Index, Gateway, ThinkLatent Portal), Jithin's mandate in his words (decision 10), the public the university lab site (projects, faculty, directors, events, press) and the scout brief (claude/scout-brief-team-site.md). Names in brackets are placeholders; numbers marked with a source are from those sources, the rest are layout values until rundown part 3.
